_comment: Default bindings for the PSP controller this package declares. The frontend ships no
bindings of its own - a package that declares a controller says how it is played by
default; the user's own bindings always win. The face-button layout follows the common
emulator convention: Z/X for the primary pair (Cross/Circle), A/S above them

PSP Controller.P1 Up: Up, J1 POV1U, X1 DpadUp, X1 LStickUp
PSP Controller.P1 Down: Down, J1 POV1D, X1 DpadDown, X1 LStickDown
PSP Controller.P1 Left: Left, J1 POV1L, X1 DpadLeft, X1 LStickLeft
PSP Controller.P1 Right: Right, J1 POV1R, X1 DpadRight, X1 LStickRight
